newsitem.title: UK: Norway's Gullfaks crude to load 23 cargoes in Apri.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Gullfaks crude to load 23 cargoes in Apri.

text.p: Norway's Gullfaks crude system is scheduled to load 23 standard 850,000-barrel cargoes in April, one fewer than in March, traders said on Friday.
The first cargo will load April 1-3, and the programme includes two cargoes loading across the end of the month between April 29 and May 1.
The total volume of crude to load in April is 19.55 million barrels, compared to 20.4 million in March, but the decrease is simply due to the shorter month, the traders said.
